about.p1: Alicia and Pedro have been teaching Salsa and Bachata for over 20 years in their own style:
about.p1Bold: warm, fun and with a lot of passion.
about.p2: As part of EPA Dancers, they regularly participate in national and international congresses and have built a community of dancers of all levels.
about.p3: Whether you've never danced before or already have experience, you'll find your place here.

faq.ctaQuestion: Have a question not listed here?

pareja.question: Do I need to come with a partner?
pareja.answer: No, the vast majority of our students come alone. In class we rotate partners continuously, so you'll meet lots of people and learn to adapt to different dance styles. Coming as a couple is welcome, but never required.

edad.question: What is the minimum age?
edad.answer: Group classes are from 16 years old. If you have doubts about whether it's right for you or someone in your family, write to us on WhatsApp and we'll help with no commitment.

cuando-empezar.question: Can I start at any time of year?
cuando-empezar.answer: Yes. We have continuous enrolment in beginner groups. No need to wait for the start of the season: you can sign up any week and follow along from day one.

ropa.question: What clothes and footwear do I need?
ropa.answer: Comfortable clothes you can move freely in. For footwear, a smooth sole that slides is ideal (dance shoes or thin-soled trainers). Avoid thick rubber soles at first, as they make turns harder.

progresion.question: How long will it take me to learn something?
progresion.answer: In the first 2-3 classes you'll be dancing basic steps and starting to feel the rhythm. Progress depends on each person, but we promise that from day one you'll leave with something to practice at home.

individuales.question: Are there private classes or only group classes?
individuales.answer: We offer both. Group classes are perfect for starting out and meeting people. Private or couples classes let you accelerate progress or prepare a special choreography. Ask us on WhatsApp.

pago.question: How does payment work? Is there an enrolment fee?
pago.answer: Payment is monthly with no enrolment fee or commitment, in cash. Four plans based on your weekly classes: 1 class (€29.90), 2 classes (€49.90), 3 classes (€65) or unlimited flat rate (€75). Private classes: price on request. You can change plan each month.
